item.description: Notably, during his election campaign, Mamdani had called Trump "despot" and a "fascist", a favourite jibe of the Left politicians and the Leftist media to target all conservatives. | OpIndia News

item.title: Himanta Biswa Sarma signs agreement with British Museum for Vrindavani Vastra: Read about Assam’s spiritual and cultural legacy
item.description: To ensure that the Vrindavani Vastra can be safely displayed in Assam, the state government and the JSW Foundation will build a world-class museum in Guwahati. | OpIndia News

item.title: The X country label feature now reveals the actual origin of influential political accounts
item.description: By showing the actual origin of user accounts, X’s update is exposing foreign-based political handles that long posed as local voices, triggering debate on transparency, credibility and the extent of overseas influence in India’s digital discourse. | OpIndia News

item.title: RTI reveals 3,355 Kurukshetra child dog bite cases between 2020 and 2025
item.description: Kurukshetra child dog bite cases have reached 3,355 since 2020, with 2025 already the worst year. RTI data shows the district forming a major share of Haryana’s total cases.

item.title: Why Punjab is opposing the centre’s 131st Amendment on Chandigarh

item.description: During election rallies in Bihar, PM Modi mentioned this phenomenon of RJD playing songs about theft, pistols, and double-barrel guns in election rallies. | OpIndia News

item.title: Canadian Federal Court rejects asylum plea of Sikh man, says his claims of persecution for being pro-Khalistan, and gay are false
item.description: Canada’s tribunal ruled Singh could safely relocate within India, citing no proof of police pursuit, Khalistan links or sexuality based danger. The case also reflects rising misuse of fabricated persecution narratives in asylum claims abroad. | OpIndia News
